cohort: A cohort of 16,581 women who delivered at two university hospitals in Ireland in 2016.
finding: The rate of red cell transfusion in an Irish obstetric cohort was 1.7%, with nulliparity, preterm delivery, postterm pregnancy, macrosomia, and multiple pregnancy being associated with increased risk, while obesity and advanced maternal age were not.
gest_age: Deliveries at <37 and >42 weeks gestation were associated with transfusion.
birth_weight: Infants with birthweight >4kg were more likely to be associated with maternal transfusion.
